content.thinking: I'll fix the two overstated sentences in compaction-basic's README to reflect the safeguard limits on pressure trimming, then regenerate the signature blocks in docs/subsystems/compaction.md.

input.old_string: Mount `dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner` before this package to trim oversized tool results as part of condensation. Trimming makes no model call and can remove the need to summarize at all: when the trimmed conversation fits within the threshold, condensation skips the summary. Trimming only runs after a condensation trigger qualifies — a below-pressure conversation is never touched.
input.new_string: Mount `dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner` before this package to trim oversized tool results as part of condensation. Trimming makes no model call and can remove the need to summarize at all: when the trimmed conversation fits within the threshold, condensation skips the summary. Trimming only runs after a condensation trigger qualifies — a below-pressure conversation is never touched. This package passes the trigger through, so under pressure the pruner keeps recent results whole and skips small gains, while overflow recovery trims every oversized result.

input.old_string: After a successful step crosses the threshold, oversized tool results are first rewritten when the optional pruner is loaded.
input.new_string: After a successful step crosses the threshold, oversized tool results are first rewritten when the optional pruner is loaded and its pressure safeguards allow it.
